description: This file contains functions and procedures for configuring, setting up, renewing, and tearing down DHCPv6 protocol in an OpenWRT network environment. It defines configuration parameters, command execution, and protocol registration.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_prefix
methods.description: Adds a prefix to the DHCPv6 request options.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_sendopts
methods.description: Adds send options to the DHCPv6 request.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_setup
methods.description: Sets up DHCPv6 on a specified interface with configuration parameters.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_renew
methods.description: Forces renewal of DHCPv6 lease on a specified interface.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_teardown
methods.description: Tears down DHCPv6 on a specified interface.
